findings.title: Worker creation failure leaves the operation pending
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Supported browser API contract failure should be fixed before publishing this refactor.
findings.evidence: In-memory synthetic Node probe; browser-boundaries harness or module namespace inspection.
findings.reproduction: Make URL.createObjectURL throw a synthetic error, then run WorkerJob with a valid compiled module and synthetic password bytes.
findings.expected: Reject with WORKER_FAILED, release the operation slot and wipe owned byte copies.
findings.observed: The run promise remains pending, ended is false, an unhandled rejection occurs and the bytes remain nonzero.
findings.impact: A browser refusing Blob URLs can leave a long-operation slot permanently busy and retain its byte copies.
findings.recommendedFix: Wrap Blob creation, URL creation and startup in one failure boundary; stop and wipe on every exception.
findings.requiredVerification: Inject Blob/URL/Worker failures and assert settled rejection, released slot and zeroed client copies.

findings.title: Wallet progress drops asynchronous callback failures
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Supported browser API contract failure should be fixed before publishing this refactor.
findings.evidence: In-memory synthetic Node probe; browser-boundaries harness or module namespace inspection.
findings.reproduction: Emit a draws message while onProgress returns a rejected Promise.
findings.expected: Reject the drawing operation with CALLBACK_FAILED and terminate its workers.
findings.observed: The wrapper does not return the callback Promise; rejection is unhandled and the drawing operation and worker continue.
findings.impact: The documented callback-failure contract fails during checked phrase generation.
findings.recommendedFix: Return the callback result so WorkerJob.callPage observes its rejection.
findings.requiredVerification: Assert asynchronous rejection cancels all drawing workers and rejects with CALLBACK_FAILED.

findings.title: Declaration error exports are missing from runtime modules
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Supported browser API contract failure should be fixed before publishing this refactor.
findings.evidence: In-memory synthetic Node probe; browser-boundaries harness or module namespace inspection.
findings.reproduction: Import MhfeError from passwords.js or repair.js, or either error class from wallet.js.
findings.expected: Named value exports promised by declarations exist in the JavaScript modules.
findings.observed: Actual module namespaces contain only their main class; the named imports fail module linking.
findings.impact: TypeScript-valid consumers fail at runtime before calling any operation.
findings.recommendedFix: Add matching JavaScript value reexports or remove the unsupported declaration exports.
findings.requiredVerification: Compare declaration value exports with actual ES-module namespaces and exercise named imports.

findings.title: Word-index generation accepts a character recipe and returns an empty password
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded native API or lifecycle defect; no current frontend compromise demonstrated.
findings.evidence: Direct source trace, not an executed native reproduction.
findings.expected: Reject a character recipe at this word-generation entry point.
findings.observed: Source trace: drawn_words is zero, no callback runs, and success returns empty text with a 93328-millibit recipe marked not weak.
findings.impact: Native library consumers can receive an empty password accompanied by strong-generation metadata. Current CLI/WASM dispatch does not call this invalid combination.
findings.recommendedFix: Reject character recipes here, as make_from_rolls already does, or separate word-recipe types.
findings.requiredVerification: Run a negative public-API regression asserting character recipes cannot produce successful empty text.

findings.title: Rekey guards declared settings while encrypting with independent engine settings
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded native API or lifecycle defect; no current frontend compromise demonstrated.
findings.evidence: Direct source trace, not an executed native reproduction.
findings.reproduction: Recover an old container at settings A/password P; seal with an Mhfe configured at A and password P but declare new_work B different from A.
findings.expected: Reject settings mismatch or use the engine's authoritative settings; unchanged rekey must be refused.
findings.observed: Source trace: check_new compares B with stored A, while Encryption runs at the supplied engine's A; deterministic output is the old container.
findings.impact: Native consumers can bypass the unchanged guard and attach recovery instructions for settings different from those used. CLI/WASM construct matching engines in reviewed paths.
findings.recommendedFix: Use mhfe.work_factor() as authoritative or reject mismatches in recover/seal before work.
findings.requiredVerification: Exercise old and new engine/declaration mismatches and unchanged-output prevention with a reduced-cost test engine.

findings.title: Invalid repetition arguments leave earlier secret byte copies unwiped
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded native API or lifecycle defect; no current frontend compromise demonstrated.
findings.evidence: In-memory synthetic Node probe; browser-boundaries harness or module namespace inspection.
findings.reproduction: Use a synthetic nonempty first password/passphrase and an invalid repetition argument (number or lone surrogate); instrument TextEncoder to observe owned arrays without printing contents.
findings.expected: Every client-owned temporary secret buffer is wiped when validation rejects.
findings.observed: The first encodeSecret succeeds; the repetition encoder throws before any cleanup guard, leaving the first array nonzero.
findings.impact: Bounded secret-lifetime regression on invalid-input paths; no persistence, network exfiltration or user-secret compromise demonstrated.
findings.recommendedFix: Use cleanup guards around staged secret encoding, following the core client's existing pattern.
findings.requiredVerification: Assert rejection wipes all allocated temporary arrays for invalid repeat types/text while preserving caller arrays.
